whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no devices will be excluded.

clientId.title: Withings Client ID
clientId.description: OAuth2 client id from your app at https://developer.withings.com/

clientSecret.title: Withings Client Secret
clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret from your Withings app.

accessToken.title: Access Token
accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token (auto-refreshed). Leave empty initially.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: OAuth2 refresh token obtained from the Authorization Code flow (scopes: user.metrics, user.activity, user.sleepevents).

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (minutes)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll the Withings cloud for new measurements (minimum 5).

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging purposes.
